static_traits.name: Li Jing
static_traits.social_status: Relationship with cycling partners affected, feeling inferior due to frequent comparison with others; has several friends to talk with, but has not yet mentioned Self-doubt issues to them.
static_traits.medical_history: Never received psychotherapy or counseling; No major physical illness.
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude; able to clearly describe automatic thoughts and emotional experiences in training scenarios; willing to explore alternative perspectives.

basic_info.main_problem: I believe I will never qualify for cycling events, and this belief has led to a sense of inadequacy and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: The key factor that made me decide to seek counseling is realizing that these negative beliefs are affecting my motivation and overall mental health.
growth_experiences: After failing to reach a personal cycling goal a few months ago, Self-doubt and sense of inadequacy intensified markedly; at the time, having placed great pressure on oneself to succeed in cycling races, initial stress levels were very high.
Similar Self-doubt and sense of inadequacy often appeared in competitive situations in the past; never received psychological treatment or counseling before; no significant physical illness history.

special_situations.event: In training, sees a group of riders speed past her, others performing better than her
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others ride better than me, it means I am not good enough / do not deserve to compete
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifies training, sets stricter goals in an attempt to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Why keep trying? I am not as good as them, I will never get the qualification

special_situations.event: Strong Anxiety surging before every training session, anticipating failure again
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If success cannot be guaranteed, then training has no meaning; one failure means I will always fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly pressuring oneself in training, trying to undo the sense of failure with stricter goals
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will fail again, has no meaning, I am doomed to fail

special_situations.event: Overall evaluation of self-ability declining comprehensively after not yet reaching a personal cycling goal a few months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail at one important goal, it means I am a failure overall
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: With harsher self-demands and training intensity, compensates for the fear of being defined as a loser
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a failure, cannot do anything well

special_situations.event: When thinking about discussing Self-doubt with cycling friends, worrying about being judged as weak or incapable
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose vulnerability, they will look down on me / think I am not capable enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying Silent, not confiding in friends, to avoid others' judgment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am weak, incompetent

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable and worthy of respect, and to be seen making progress and having value in cycling
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as incompetent, appearing inferior after comparison, then being looked down upon or distanced
defense_goal: Maintains a controllable self-image through self-blame and stricter goals
Keeps silent, avoids exposing vulnerability to evade others' judgment

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, a person easily defined as a failure
object_relations.object_representation: Others / peers who are more outstanding and may judge her

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores sharing feelings with friends or suggests seeking peer support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client believes friends will judge oneself as weak and incapable like competitors (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing worry about being looked down upon in a hesitant and defensive tone, avoiding deep specifics, often using 'they will think...' in statements.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out their generalizing a single failure into an overall failure, and inquires into the function of the training strategy
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client interprets overtraining as a necessary act of 'being responsible for oneself', to fend off the Anxiety of being seen as a failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using rational Interpretation and 'should/must' wording to explain why stricter goals are needed, in a firm tone but avoiding emotional-level discussion.

manifestations: Feeling 'already defeated' before starting training, believing training has no meaning
A single failure is experienced as an overall failure, thereby weakening the enjoyment of leisure in life
outcomes: Difficulty relaxing on weekends, interests impaired

manifestations: Worrying about being judged as weak by friends and thus not daring to share inner troubles
Relationship with cycling partners damaged by comparison
outcomes: Decreased quality of interaction with others

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing peers will look down on oneself, attributing the feeling of 'I am not good enough' to others' evaluation
In socializing, presets the other party's negative views and stays silent

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Keeps pressuring themselves with stricter goals
Frequent Self-denial and comparison in training and relationships, limiting self-expression

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the behavioral impulse he wants to make toward other people or things, and turns the energy originally intended to be sent outward toward himself, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not seeking support from friends but choosing to intensify training to 'deal with' oneself
Transforming the comfort and understanding that should be sought outward into internal self-blame

positive_force: Has some cycling training foundation and past achievements (can serve as evidence to remind myself)
Has self-observation and expression abilities, willing to try alternative viewpoints
Work performance not yet directly affected, life structure relatively stable
Has some friend resources; potential social support exists
negative_force: Tendency toward catastrophizing and predicting the future
Comparing oneself with others leads to self-deprecation
Overly setting strict goals, continuously pressuring oneself
Unwillingness to express vulnerability to friends making support hard to obtain
Overgeneralizing one failure as overall failure

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and the feeling of 'being already defeated' before training, mind wandering or being unable to finish midway during training
antecedent: Recalling the goal not yet reached a few months ago
Seeing others ride faster or perform better
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic view of failure and negative expectations of predicting the future, driven by the self-label 'failure'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding perceived failure and judgment, reducing Anxiety short-term
target_behavior.consequence: Declining training quality, unable to complete plans, further reinforcing Self-doubt and failure beliefs

target_behavior.behavior: In training and goal setting, continually raises the bar, setting overly strict goals
antecedent: Self-denial after one failure or not yet meeting the standard
target_behavior.core_reason: Trying to compensate for the core belief of 'not good enough' through self-reproach and higher standards
target_behavior.function: Gains a short-term sense of control and self-soothing (feels one is taking action)
target_behavior.consequence: Increased stress, worsened experience, further declining motivation, Self-doubt worsens

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance: not discussing Self-doubt and training troubles with friends
antecedent: Thinking of communicating with friends while worrying about being judged as weak or incapable
Interacting with cycling partners or thinking of their views
target_behavior.core_reason: Tendencies toward mind reading and personalization of others' negative evaluations, fears exposure of vulnerability
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential shame and the feeling of being negated
target_behavior.consequence: Social support hard to obtain, Interpersonal relationships damaged, persistent sense of Loneliness and Negative emotions
